allowed_flow_variations: The harness may enable retiming or physical optimization. The candidate's retained synthesis script is authoritative for its actual settings.
authority: Harness evidence is fixed. Proposed architectural goals cannot redefine it.

build_spec.authority: Complete resolved typed build contract. Defined behavior is mandatory; explicitly unspecified cases remain unspecified. Frozen implementation identities do not turn incidental values in unspecified cases into requirements.

modules.behavior: Parameterized unsigned iterative divider, public parameter WIDTH=8. Supported experiment domain: integer WIDTH 1..16. Preserve unsigned symbolic [WIDTH-1:0] dividend, divisor, quotient and remainder ports and actual WIDTH-dependent arithmetic and schedule, not only defaults. Preferred implementation is restoring division with a WIDTH+1-bit trial remainder and one bounded arithmetic step per compute edge. Capture dividend and divisor only on in_valid && in_ready at rising edge k. There is one outstanding transaction. Define internal computing state busy and held-result flag out_valid: in_ready equals !busy && !out_valid, independent of out_ready and without combinational reset gating. During computing or while a result is held, do not accept another request. Execute exactly WIDTH compute iterations at edges k+1 through k+WIDTH; no arithmetic iteration occurs at capture. out_valid first becomes visible after the NBA update of edge k+WIDTH, with quotient and remainder final together. Earliest retirement is edge k+WIDTH+1; no early result for zero, divisor one, equal operands, dividend smaller than divisor, or divide by zero. At the edge that retires a held result, in_ready was false, so a new request cannot be accepted until a later edge (earliest the following edge). For nonzero divisor, quotient=floor(dividend/divisor) and remainder=dividend%divisor. For divisor zero, quotient is all WIDTH ones and remainder is the captured original dividend, on the same fixed schedule. Ignore operand/input-valid noise after capture until the next accepted transaction. Hold out_valid and the atomic quotient/remainder tuple stable while stalled, until transfer or reset; invalid output fields are unspecified. Synchronous active-high rst aborts computation and any held result at the rising edge and overrides all transfers. Reset has no effect between edges; do not gate handshake or output signals combinationally with rst. After reset, no abandoned result may appear. Numeric latency=9 and // @latency 9 describe only default WIDTH=8 minimum accepted-transfer age; overridden children must satisfy WIDTH+1 age and the exact availability schedule above, checked independently. For the Python scoreboard oracle ONLY, each non-reset step represents one accepted dividend/divisor pair: return its eventual unsigned quotient and remainder masked to default WIDTH, including the explicit divide-by-zero rule. The oracle is arithmetic, not a busy/ready scheduling model or delay queue; init() represents reset state and supplied rst must be handled. Independent temporal verification checks scheduling, stalls, aborts and selected parameter overrides. Behavioral tests establish arithmetic and schedule, not physical iterative structure; retain source review of the sequential implementation for that claim.
modules.name: iterative_divider_core

declared_latency.meaning: A source annotation declares numeric latency only when present. This known/cycles pair is authoritative for the current top module's annotation requirement. Only known=true requires a matching numeric top annotation. Child typed-module latency does not invent a top annotation for arbitrary aggregate wrappers. When known=false, absence of a top annotation is not a failed or unverifiable criterion. Unannotated numeric latency is UNKNOWN, not zero. Preserve the source's exact observable cycles and registered behavior. Annotation presence or absence alone is not independent proof of behavioral correctness; use the fixed source contract, all defined typed latency/minimum transfer age and deterministic verification, without inventing a numeric requirement.

edit_scope.reason: The supplied testbench instantiates the top iterative_divider and is the trusted integration authority, so every generated child module and the mechanical top form one editable unit verified through the top. Per-child generated oracles and testbenches verified the baseline children only and are not evidence for changed children.

implementation.meaning: Chip-top implementation: the top is the whole FPGA design. Every port bit gets an I/O buffer on a package pin, and data ports have zero input and output delay to clk, so the routed WNS and WHS include pad delay. Utilization includes the I/O buffers.

metric_provenance: Structured metrics are parsed from retained reports; routed utilization/timing reports take precedence when present. The manifest identifies complete files by hash. Header excerpts are bounded previews, not complete reports or an independent metric source.
objective_policy: First establish timing feasibility. A verified timing-feasible candidate may replace a known timing-infeasible previous best even with higher area or power; classify this as timing_recovery, not objective savings. While the previous best is timing-infeasible, a verified still-infeasible candidate with strictly better setup WNS and hold not worse beyond a small tolerance may replace it as timing_progress, which is not closure; a feasible candidate always outranks it. Once both are timing-feasible, require strict improvement of the chosen objective; for maximize_freq that is register-to-register setup slack (reg2reg_wns_ns) when both designs report it, otherwise full setup WNS for both, while feasibility stays on full WNS and WHS. minimize_luts compares (lut_used, ff_used) and minimize_ffs compares (ff_used, lut_used) lexicographically: an equal primary metric with a strictly lower secondary is an objective improvement, a higher primary never is, and a secondary missing from either design gives no tie-break. Unknown or contradictory incumbent timing evidence cannot establish recovery. A completed experiment may find no improvement. Do not invent mandatory savings, slack margins, tool versions, timing corners, new tests, thresholds, code-style quotas or external environment requirements.
